posts.title: What's "IRL," Really?
posts.description: As evidenced by the WTO protests, Occupy and the Arab Spring, the term "IRL" was inaccurate and ableist. The battle for "The People's Tech" is real – and I hope you'll join me in fighting it.

posts.title: Bluesky Vision
posts.description: Psst, can you get me an invite code? Everyone wants to be part of the Next Big Thing that's just like the last one. That may not bode well.

posts.title: Fear Makes the Wolf Look Bigger
posts.description: The enemy is smaller than we think – just amplified.
